adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a `cook_method` enum with `:raw_html` and changes `Post#cook` to `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `skip_validations: true`, and `Jobs::PollFeed` passes `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` straight into `TopicEmbed.import` with no sanitization/whitelisting. As a result, arbitrary HTML from an RSS/Atom feed can be stored as `cooked` verbatim and later rendered (e.g., embed view uses `<%= raw post.cooked %>`), enabling stored XSS if feed content includes scripts/handlers/javascript: URLs.
